activity.role: President of the Founding Junta of the Second Republic
activity.notes: De facto provisional government head: President of the Junta Fundadora de la Segunda República, established after Costa Rica's 1948 civil war. The Costa Rican National Archive lists the Junta's effective tenure through 7 November 1949; on 8 November 1949 José Figueres Ferrer handed executive power to elected President Otilio Ulate Blanco. These are last governing day versus handover boundary, NOT inconsistent overlapping presidential terms. It was not a popularly elected constitutional presidency, nor a distinct sovereign Republic of Costa Rica. Reuse the existing Costa Rica Polity and distinguish the provisional Junta as a role/institution, not an independently invented territorial state.
